exercises.explanationUz:
BU BET - KITOBNING OLD MUQOVASI.

  Mashq yo'q, bet raqami ham yo'q.


MUQOVADAGI MATN:

  Elementary          - daraja
  COURSEBOOK          - kitob turi
  ENTERPRISE          - seriya nomi
  2                   - bosqich raqami
  Virginia Evans -
     Jenny Dooley     - mualliflar
  Express Publishing  - nashriyot


⚠ 'ELEMENTARY' SO'ZI NIMA DEGANI:

  'elementary' = boshlang'ich, eng oddiy,
  asosiy.

  ⚠ 'an element' = element, unsur
     → 'elementary' (sifat) = elementar

  ⚠ Ingliz tili darajalari ketma-ketligi:
     Beginner      - mutlaqo boshlovchi
     ELEMENTARY    - boshlang'ich  ← BU KITOB
     Pre-Intermediate
     Intermediate
     Upper-Intermediate
     Advanced

  ⚠ Ya'ni siz Beginner'ni tugatib, IKKINChI
  bosqichga o'tdingiz.


⚠ 'ENTERPRISE' SO'ZI:

  'an enterprise' ikki ma'noda:
     1) TAShABBUS, jasorat, dadillik
     2) KORXONA, tadbirkorlik

  ⚠ Kitob nomida BIRINChI ma'no.


⚠ RANG FARQI:

  Enterprise 1 (Beginner) - OCh YAShIL fon,
     PUShTI yozuvlar
  Enterprise 2 (Elementary) - TO'Q SARIQ fon,
     YAShIL yozuvlar

  ⚠ Seriyadagi har kitobning o'z rangi bor -
  javondan tanib olish oson bo'lsin uchun.


MUQOVADAGI SURATLAR:

  1) To'siqdan sakrayotgan OT va chavandoz
     ⚠ 'show jumping' = to'siqlardan sakrash
     sporti.

  2) Qizil va sariq LOLALAR
     ⚠ 'a tulip' = lola.

  3) Daraxt yonida KITOB O'QIYaPGAN qiz

  4) Qizil xitoy libosidagi IKKI QIZ

  ⚠ To'rt surat - to'rt xil dunyo: sport,
  tabiat, o'qish, madaniyat. Kitob ham shu
  mavzular haqida.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  elementary    = boshlang'ich
  an element    = element, unsur
  a coursebook  = darslik
  a publisher   = nashriyot
  an author     = muallif
  a tulip       = lola
  show jumping  = to'siqdan sakrash sporti
  a horse rider = chavandoz

BU BET - TITUL VARAG'I.

  ⚠ Inglizcha: 'the title page'.

  Mashq yo'q, bet raqami ham yo'q.


NIMA UChUN KERAK:

  Titul varag'i muqovadagi MATNNI
  takrorlaydi, lekin SURATSIZ.

  ⚠ Bu - nashriyot an'anasi: muqova
  yirtilib ketsa ham kitobning nomi
  ichkarida qoladi.

  ⚠ Kutubxonalar kitobni aynan TITUL
  VARAG'IGA qarab ro'yxatga oladi,
  muqovaga emas.


BETDAGI MATN (yuqoridan pastga):

  ENTERPRISE 2        - seriya va bosqich
  COURSEBOOK          - kitob turi
  Elementary          - daraja
  Virginia Evans -
     Jenny Dooley     - mualliflar
  Express Publishing  - nashriyot


⚠ 'A TITLE' - IKKI MA'NO:

  1) NOM, sarlavha
     'The title of the book is
      Enterprise 2.'

  2) UNVON (Mr, Mrs, Dr, Professor)
     'Please write your title and name.'

  ⚠ 'a title page' = titul varag'i
  ⚠ 'entitled' = deb nomlangan


⚠ RANGLAR MUQOVA BILAN BIR XIL:

  ENTERPRISE 2 - to'q sariq
  COURSEBOOK   - yashil
  Elementary   - to'q sariq

  ⚠ Beginner kitobida bu ranglar
  pushti va yashil edi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a title       = nom, sarlavha
  a title page  = titul varag'i
  a cover       = muqova
  a page        = bet
  to publish    = nashr qilmoq
  a publisher   = nashriyot

BU BET - MUNDARIJA (2-bet).

  ⚠ Inglizcha: 'Contents'.
  HAR DOIM KO'PLIKDA yoziladi.


MUNDARIJA IKKI BETLIK:

  BU BET (2)         Keyingi bet (3)
  ---------------    ------------------
  GRAMMAR            LISTENING & SPEAKING
  VOCABULARY         COMMUNICATION
  READING            WRITING

  ⚠ Ya'ni har unit uchun OLTI ustun bor.
  Ularni birga o'qish kerak: jadvalning
  chap yarmi bu betda, o'ng yarmi
  keyingisida.


KITOBNING TUZILIShI:

  4 MODUL, jami 15 UNIT:

  MODUL 1 - Unit 1, 2, 3, 4
  MODUL 2 - Unit 5, 6, 7, 8
  MODUL 3 - Unit 9, 10, 11, 12
  MODUL 4 - Unit 13, 14, 15

  ⚠ Beginner'da 20 unit bor edi -
  bu kitobda unitlar KAMROQ, lekin
  har biri KATTAROQ (6 betdan).


QO'ShIMChA BO'LIMLAR:

  1) STORY - HIKOYa (komiks)
     Story 1: The Shark Caller
        (Akula chaqiruvchi) - 2 qism
     Story 2: The Python Hunt
        (Piton ovi) - 2 qism
     Story 3: On the Top of the World
        (Dunyoning tepasida)

     ⚠ Har hikoya bir grammatika
     mavzusiga bog'langan:
        Shark Caller 1: must, can't, will
        Shark Caller 2: conditionals type 0
        Python Hunt 1: too - enough
        Python Hunt 2: some - any - no

  2) MODULE SELF-ASSESSMENT
     = MODUL O'Z-O'ZINI BAHOLASh
     Har modul oxirida, 2 betdan.

     ⚠ Beginner'da bu 'Revision'
     deb atalgan edi.

  3) GRAMMAR REFERENCE SECTION
     = grammatika ma'lumotnomasi

  4) IRREGULAR VERBS
     = noto'g'ri fe'llar ro'yxati

  5) WORD LIST
     = so'zlar ro'yxati

  6) PHOTO FILE SECTION
     = suratli lug'at bo'limi


⚠ 'CONTENTS' - DIQQAT:

  'content' (birlikda, urg'u OXIRIDA:
  conTENT) = qanoat, mamnun

  'contents' (ko'plikda, urg'u
  BOShIDA: CONtents) = mundarija,
  ichidagi narsalar

  ⚠ Kitobda HAR DOIM 'Contents'.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  contents      = mundarija
  a module      = modul
  a unit        = bo'lim, dars
  grammar       = grammatika
  vocabulary    = lug'at
  reading       = o'qish
  a story       = hikoya
  an episode    = qism, epizod
  self-assessment = o'z-o'zini baholash
  a reference   = ma'lumotnoma
  irregular     = noto'g'ri, qoidasiz
  a word list   = so'zlar ro'yxati

exercises.instructionUz: Mundarija - TINGLASH VA GAPIRISH, MULOQOT, YOZISH ustunlari.
exercises.explanationUz:
BU BET - MUNDARIJANING O'NG YARMI (3-bet).

  Sarlavha yo'q, chunki bu 2-betdagi
  JADVALNING DAVOMI.


UChTA USTUN:

  LISTENING & SPEAKING
     = tinglash va gapirish

  COMMUNICATION
     = muloqot (nutq vazifalari)

  WRITING
     = yozish

  ⚠ 2-betdagi ustunlar bilan birga
  OLTITA bo'ladi:
     GRAMMAR, VOCABULARY, READING,
     LISTENING & SPEAKING,
     COMMUNICATION, WRITING


⚠ TO'RT KO'NIKMA - IKKI GURUH:

  RECEPTIVE (qabul qiluvchi):
     reading  - o'qish
     listening - tinglash

  PRODUCTIVE (faol, o'zi hosil qiladigan):
     speaking - gapirish
     writing  - yozish

  ⚠ Kitob har unitda TO'RTALASINI ham
  mashq qildiradi.


⚠ 'PRONUNCIATION' HAR QATORDA:

  Har unitning LISTENING & SPEAKING
  ustuni oxirida 'Pronunciation:'
  yozuvi bor.

  = TALAFFUZ mashqi.

  Kitob bo'yicha talaffuz mavzulari:
     1  similar sounds - o'xshash tovushlar
     2  silent letters - o'qilmaydigan harflar
     3  /h/ tovushi
     4  sentence stress - gap urg'usi
     5  'll qisqartmasi
     6  like / 'd like farqi
     7  /id/ tovushi
     8  /o:/ - /o/ farqi
     9  word stress - so'z urg'usi
     10 must/mustn't
     11 /e/ tovushi (schwa)
     12 words that rhyme - qofiyalanuvchi so'zlar
     13 syllable stress - bo'g'in urg'usi
     14 Intonation - ohang
     15 Intonation in question tags

  ⚠ 'to pronounce' = talaffuz qilmoq
     → 'pronunciation' = talaffuz
  ⚠ DIQQAT: fe'lda 'nounce', otda
  'nunci' - imlo O'ZGARADI. Bu -
  ingliz tilidagi eng ko'p xato
  qilinadigan so'zlardan biri.


⚠ HAR UNITDA 'PROJECT' BOR:

  WRITING ustunida har qatorda
  'Project - ...' yozuvi bor.

  = uyga katta yozma ish.

  ⚠ 'a project' = loyiha, katta ish.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  listening     = tinglash
  speaking      = gapirish
  communication = muloqot
  writing       = yozish
  pronunciation = talaffuz
  to pronounce  = talaffuz qilmoq
  stress        = urg'u
  a syllable    = bo'g'in
  intonation    = ohang
  to rhyme      = qofiyalanmoq
  a project     = loyiha
  a leaflet     = varaqa, buklet
  a report      = hisobot, xabar

BU BET - MUALLIFLIK HUQUQI VA
MINNATDORChILIK.

  Mashq yo'q, lekin bu yerda juda
  ko'p RASMIY IBORA bor - ular
  hujjatlarda doim uchraydi.


NAShRIYOT MANZILI:

  Express Publishing
  Liberty House, New Greenham Park,
  Newbury, Berkshire RG19 6HW

  ⚠ Ingliz manzili TESKARI tartibda:
     bino → ko'cha/park → shahar →
     grafi (county) → indeks

  ⚠ 'RG19 6HW' - POSTCODE
  (pochta indeksi). Britaniyada u
  HARF VA RAQAM aralash bo'ladi.
  AQShda esa faqat raqam (ZIP code).


⚠ TEL. VA FAX RAQAMLARI:

  (0044) - Buyuk Britaniya kodi.
  ⚠ Odatda '+44' deb yoziladi.


⚠ 'ALL RIGHTS RESERVED':

  = barcha huquqlar himoyalangan.

  To'liq jumla:
  'No part of this publication may be
   reproduced ... without the prior
   written permission of the publishers.'
  = Nashrning hech bir qismi nashriyotning
    OLDINDAN YOZMA ruxsatisiz
    ko'paytirilishi mumkin emas.

  ⚠ 'may be reproduced' - MAJHUL
  NISBAT (passive). Bu 9-unitning
  grammatika mavzusi.

  ⚠ 'prior' = oldingi, oldindan.
  ⚠ 'permission' = ruxsat.


⚠ NAShR TARIXI:

  First edition, 1999
  New edition, 2000

  ⚠ 'an edition' = nashr.
  ⚠ 'to edit' = tahrirlash
     → 'an editor' = muharrir
     → 'an edition' = nashr


⚠ ISBN 1-84216-105-9

  = International Standard Book Number
  = Xalqaro standart kitob raqami.

  ⚠ Dunyodagi har kitobning O'Z ISBN
  raqami bor - xuddi pasport kabi.


⚠ 'ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS':

  = minnatdorchilik, tan olish.

  ⚠ 'to acknowledge' = tan olmoq,
  e'tirof etmoq.

  ⚠ Bu so'zning imlosi qiyin:
     a-c-k-n-o-w-l-e-d-g-e-m-e-n-t-s
  Ichida 'know' so'zi yashiringan!

  ⚠ AQShda 'acknowledgments'
  (o'rtadagi 'e'siz) ham yoziladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Introduction - Enterprise 2 Elementary is a complete course for students studying English at elementary level.
exercises.instructionUz: Kirish - Enterprise 2 Elementary boshlang'ich darajada ingliz tili o'rganuvchilar uchun to'liq kurs.
exercises.explanationUz:
BU BET - KITOBGA KIRISh (5-bet).

  U ASOSAN O'QITUVChI UChUN yozilgan,
  lekin o'quvchi ham undan katta foyda
  oladi: kitob QANDAY tuzilganini va
  har bo'lim NIMA UChUN kerakligini
  bilgan odam tezroq o'rganadi.


KURSNING HAJMI:

  15 UNIT, 4 MODUL
  70-75 DARS SOATI

  ⚠ 'may be covered in 70-75 teaching
  hours' = 70-75 dars soatida
  o'tilishi mumkin.
  ⚠ 'to cover' bu yerda = o'tmoq,
  qamrab olmoq.


HAR UNITNING TUZILIShI:

  1) LEAD-IN
     = KIRISh, mavzuga olib kirish.
     O'quvchi biladigan narsadan
     boshlanadi, yangi lug'at va
     grammatika oldindan ko'rsatiladi.
     Oxirida TINGLASh mashqi.

     ⚠ 'to lead in' = ichkariga
     boshlab kirmoq.

  2) READING
     = O'QISh. 200-350 so'zli matnlar.

     ⚠ Sub-skills (kichik ko'nikmalar):
        'reading for gist' = umumiy
           mazmunni tushunish uchun o'qish
        'reading for specific information'
           = aniq ma'lumot izlab o'qish

  3) LANGUAGE DEVELOPMENT
     = TIL RIVOJI. Ikki qismdan:

        VOCABULARY - lug'at.
        ⚠ Ayniqsa COLLOCATIONS -
        so'zlarning doimiy birikmalari
        (masalan 'make a mistake', lekin
        'do homework'). Ularni ALOHIDA
        emas, BIRGA yodlash kerak.

        GRAMMAR - grammatika.

  4) READING AND LISTENING
     = o'qish va tinglash birga.

  5) PRONUNCIATION
     = TALAFFUZ. Hamma talaffuz
     mashqlari kassetada.

  6) COMMUNICATION
     = MULOQOT. Haqiqiy hayotdagi
     vaziyatlar: qabul qilish, rad etish,
     narx so'rash, odamlarni kutib olish.

     ⚠ 'sociolinguistic features' =
     tilning ijtimoiy tomoni: kimga
     QANDAY gapirish kerak (do'stga
     boshqacha, rasmiy odamga boshqacha).

  7) WRITING
     = YOZISh. Xatlar, tavsiflar,
     hikoyalar, maqolalar.

  8) REVISION UNITS
     = TAKRORLASh. Har TO'RTINChI
     unitdan keyin.

     ⚠ MUHIM NOMUVOFIQLIK: kirishda
     'Revision Units' deyilgan, lekin
     mundarijada va kitob ichida ular
     'MODULE SELF-ASSESSMENT' deb
     nomlangan.

  9) THREE ADVENTURE STORIES
     = uchta sarguzasht hikoya,
     'comic strip' (komiks) shaklida,
     har biri ikki qismdan.

     ⚠ 'entertaining' = qiziqarli,
     ko'ngil ochadigan.
     ⚠ 'an adventure' = sarguzasht.


KURS BILAN NIMA KELADI:

  a) Teacher's Book
     = o'qituvchi kitobi (to'liq javoblar
       va testlar bilan)

  b) Class cassettes / CDs va
     Student's cassettes / CDs
     = sinf va o'quvchi uchun yozuvlar

  c) Enterprise 2 Elementary Workbook
     = mashq daftari

  d) Enterprise 2 Test Booklet
     = testlar to'plami: 9 ta test,
       Mid-term test (o'rta muddat testi)
       va Exit test (yakuniy test)

  ⚠ 'to accompany' = hamrohlik qilmoq
     → 'accompanied by' = ... bilan birga
     keladi.


⚠ IKKI MUHIM ATAMA:

  RECEPTIVE SKILLS (qabul qiluvchi):
     reading, listening

  PRODUCTIVE SKILLS (faol):
     speaking, writing

  ⚠ Kirishning birinchi jumlasida
  aynan shu ikki so'z ishlatilgan.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an introduction = kirish
  a course        = kurs
  complete        = to'liq
  extensive       = keng, mo'l
  systematic      = tizimli
  productive      = faol, hosil qiluvchi
  receptive       = qabul qiluvchi
  a syllabus      = o'quv dasturi
  an approach     = yondashuv
  graded          = darajalangan
  to acquire      = egallamoq
  acquisition     = egallash
  a lead-in       = kirish qismi
  gist            = umumiy mazmun
  a sub-skill     = kichik ko'nikma
  a collocation   = so'z birikmasi
  to consolidate  = mustahkamlamoq
  revision        = takrorlash
  entertaining    = qiziqarli
  an adventure    = sarguzasht
  a comic strip   = komiks
  to accompany    = hamrohlik qilmoq
  a booklet       = kitobcha
  to assess       = baholamoq

tasks.en: Introduction - Enterprise 2 Elementary is a complete course for students studying English at elementary level.
tasks.uz: Kirish - Enterprise 2 Elementary boshlang'ich darajada ingliz tili o'rganuvchilar uchun to'liq kurs.

tasks.en: Enterprise 2 Elementary is a complete course for students studying English at elementary level.
tasks.uz: Enterprise 2 Elementary - boshlang'ich darajada ingliz tili o'rganuvchilar uchun to'liq kurs.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'complete' = to'liq, tugal.
⚠ 'studying' - PRESENT PARTICIPLE:
'students studying English' = ingliz tilini
o'rganayotgan o'quvchilar.

tasks.en: It provides them with extensive, systematic and well-integrated practice in the productive and receptive skills.
tasks.uz: U faol va qabul qiluvchi ko'nikmalar bo'yicha keng, tizimli va yaxshi uyg'unlashgan mashq beradi.
tasks.note:
⚠ PRODUCTIVE = speaking, writing
⚠ RECEPTIVE = reading, listening

⚠ 'to provide sb WITH sth' = kimnidir nimadir
bilan ta'minlamoq. Predlog 'with'.

tasks.en: The course consists of fifteen units in four modules.
tasks.uz: Kurs to'rt moduldagi o'n beshta unitdan iborat.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to consist OF' = ... dan iborat bo'lmoq.
Predlog 'of' - HAR DOIM.

⚠ Bu fe'l CONTINUOUS shaklda ishlatilmaydi:
'is consisting' - XATO.

tasks.en: In total, Enterprise 2 Elementary may be covered in 70-75 teaching hours.
tasks.uz: Jami Enterprise 2 Elementary 70-75 dars soatida o'tilishi mumkin.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'in total' = jami.
⚠ 'to cover' bu yerda = o'tmoq, qamrab olmoq
(odatdagi 'yopmoq' ma'nosida emas).

tasks.en: Lead-in sections draw on the students' knowledge of the given topic.
tasks.uz: Lead-in bo'limlari o'quvchining mavzu bo'yicha mavjud bilimiga tayanadi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to draw on sth' = nimadandir foydalanmoq,
unga tayanmoq.

⚠ Ya'ni dars YANGI narsadan emas, o'quvchi
BILADIGAN narsadan boshlanadi.

tasks.en: Reading sections consist of 200- to 350-word texts on factual topics.
tasks.uz: O'qish bo'limlari haqiqiy mavzulardagi 200-350 so'zli matnlardan iborat.
tasks.note:
⚠ '200-word text' - son bilan ot birga sifat
bo'lganda ot BIRLIKDA qoladi va DEFIS qo'yiladi:
'a 200-word text', 'a five-year-old boy'.

tasks.en: A particular feature of the book is the teaching of collocations.
tasks.uz: Kitobning alohida xususiyati - so'z birikmalarini o'rgatish.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'a collocation' = doimiy so'z birikmasi.

⚠ Masalan: 'make a mistake' (do emas),
'do homework' (make emas).

⚠ Ularni ALOHIDA emas, BIRGA yodlash kerak -
bu ilovaning ham asosiy g'oyasi.

tasks.en: Pronunciation activities help students to recognise sounds and reproduce them correctly.
tasks.uz: Talaffuz mashqlari tovushlarni tanib olishga va to'g'ri takrorlashga yordam beradi.

tasks.en: Communication sections ... include language functions (i.e. accepting, refusing etc.).
tasks.uz: Muloqot bo'limlari til vazifalarini (qabul qilish, rad etish va h.k.) o'z ichiga oladi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'i.e.' = 'id est' (lotincha) = ya'ni.
⚠ 'etc.' = 'et cetera' = va hokazo.

⚠ 'to accept' = qabul qilmoq
⚠ 'to refuse' = rad etmoq

tasks.en: Revision Units after every fourth unit reinforce the students' understanding.
tasks.uz: Har to'rtinchi unitdan keyingi takrorlash bo'limlari tushunishni mustahkamlaydi.
tasks.note:
⚠ NOMUVOFIQLIK: kirishda 'Revision Units',
mundarijada esa 'MODULE SELF-ASSESSMENT'.
Bir narsaning ikki nomi.

⚠ 'to reinforce' = mustahkamlamoq.

tasks.en: Three entertaining adventure stories in a 'comic strip' format, presented in two episodes each.
tasks.uz: Uchta qiziqarli sarguzasht hikoya komiks shaklida, har biri ikki qismda.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'entertaining' = qiziqarli.
⚠ 'an adventure' = sarguzasht.
⚠ 'a comic strip' = komiks (rasmli hikoya).

⚠ DIQQAT: mundarijada uchinchi hikoya
('On the Top of the World') QISMLARGA
bo'linmagan - u 4 betlik yaxlit hikoya.

tasks.en: The course is accompanied by: a) Teacher's Book; b) Class cassettes or CDs; c) Workbook; d) Test Booklet.
tasks.uz: Kurs bilan birga: a) O'qituvchi kitobi; b) Sinf kassetalari yoki CD; c) Mashq daftari; d) Testlar to'plami.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to accompany' = hamrohlik qilmoq
→ 'is accompanied by' - MAJHUL NISBAT.

⚠ Test Booklet'da 9 ta test, Mid-term test
(o'rta muddat) va Exit test (yakuniy) bor.

wordFormation.explanationUz: 'title page' shu qoidadan: birinchi ot sifat vazifasini bajaradi.

wordFormation.ruleUz: ⚠ INKOR QO'ShIMChASI: IR- / IM- / IN- / UN-
wordFormation.explanationUz: 'irregular' shu qoidadan. Qaysi qo'shimcha kelishi so'zning birinchi harfiga bog'liq.
Mundarijadagi to'rt ko'nikma nomi shu qoidadan.
Betda 'senior' bor — uning juftini ham biling.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: This book is by Virginia Evans and Jenny Dooley.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu kitob Virjiniya Evans va Jenni Duli tomonidan yozilgan.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: This book is for elementary students.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu kitob boshlang'ich daraja o'quvchilari uchun.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ 'for' + kim uchun. Daraja nomi sifat sifatida turadi.

sentencePatterns.formula: On the cover I can see [nima].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: On the cover I can see a horse and some tulips.

sentencePatterns.formula: The title of the book is [nom].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The title of the book is Enterprise 2.

sentencePatterns.formula: There is no [nima] on this page.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There is no picture on this page.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ 'There is no ...' — 'There isn't a ...' bilan bir xil ma'no, lekin qat'iyroq.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The book consists of fifteen units.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'to consist OF' — predlog 'of' HAR DOIM.
⚠ Bu fe'l continuous shaklda ishlatilmaydi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Unit 6 is about food and drinks.

sentencePatterns.formula: In Unit [raqam] we learn how to [nima qilish].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: In Unit 3 we learn how to ask about prices.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'learn how to' + INFINITIV.
⚠ 'how to' — 'qanday qilib' ma'nosida.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The pronunciation topic is silent letters.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'pronunciation' — imlosi fe'ldan FARQ QILADI:
proNOUNCE lekin proNUNCIation.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: This book is published by Express Publishing.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu kitob Express Publishing tomonidan nashr etilgan.

sentencePatterns.formula: No part of this [nima] may be [3-shakl].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: No part of this book may be copied.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu kitobning hech bir qismi nusxalanishi mumkin emas.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ MODAL + MAJHUL: 'may be' + 3-shakl.
⚠ 'No part ...' — inkor EGADA, fe'lda emas.

sentencePatterns.formula: I would like to thank [kim] for [nima].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I would like to thank my teacher for her help.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'to thank sb FOR sth' — predlog 'for'.
⚠ Betdagi matn aynan shu qolip bilan boshlanadi:
'We would like to thank ...'

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The course consists of fifteen units.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'to consist OF' — predlog 'of' HAR DOIM.
⚠ Continuous shaklda ishlatilmaydi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It provides students with extensive practice.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U o'quvchilarni keng mashq bilan ta'minlaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'to provide sb WITH sth' — predlog 'with'.
⚠ Yoki: 'to provide sth FOR sb'.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The course is accompanied by a workbook.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kurs bilan birga mashq daftari keladi.
